messages:
sophie: heads up — saw a ~6 BLEU drop on ja->en and zh->en in nightly eval after int8 quant rollout to staging. Samples attached.

kevin: oh no. which model + quant config?

sophie: model: rlm-13b-v2, quant: int8_dynamic, kernel: fused-attn-v2, batch=1

sophie: eval job: /evals/multilang/2024-11-30/round3 — CI shows BLEU_ja=21.4 (prev 27.2)

arjun: do we have tokenization diffs? CJK merges sometimes change subword boundaries.

yuki: I ran tokenizer diff: 120k tokens changed, example: '東京大学' -> ['東京', '大学'] vs ['東京大', '学'] (wrong split)

sophie: pasted an example:
```
src: 東京大学に行きました。
pred_prev: I went to the University of Tokyo.
pred_now: I went to Tokyo University.
```

kevin: those are similar though — BLEU drop seems larger.

ml-eval-bot: automated-runner: eval_id=eval-20241130-multilang-03, metric: BLEU, zh->en prev=28.1 now=22.0, ja->en prev=27.2 now=21.4, rouge1 -4.2

arjun: could be softmax temperature differences due to quantization noise -> more tokenization boundary shifts amplify.

yuki: also saw increased unk/subword tokens for emoji and punctuation in mixed-script lines.

sophie: repro steps: checkout tags/rlm-13b-v2, quantize with q8/ng=off then qint8_dynamic, run ./tools/run_eval.sh --langs ja,zh --seed 42

kevin: can you dump logits around boundary? sample id 98765

sophie: attached logits snippet and token ids:
```
ids: [1024, 34012, 7, 4021]
logits_before_quant: [ -0.2, 1.4, 0.11, 0.01]
logits_after_quant: [ -0.3, 1.1, 0.5, -0.6]
```

arjun: interesting: logits_after has higher peak at a subword leading to different BPE split

yuki: workaround idea: re-run tokenizers with nbest_merge=5 or force a Unicode normalization NFKC pass pre-tokenize

kevin: for quick mitigation let's pin staging to q8 and roll back int8_dynamic until we root cause. I'll open a ticket.

sophie: thanks. I'll add failing examples to the eval suite and run a targeted quant sensitivity sweep (vary scale, per-channel vs global).

arjun: also drop a diff of vocabulary merges: /artifacts/tokenizer/vocab_delta_20241130.json

sophie: adding @ml-infra to FYI — might need kernel fallback if fused-attn-v2 introduces different rounding. :eyes:

kevin: created GH issue #1427: 'int8 quant caused CJK subword regression on rlm-13b-v2' — assign arjun/sophie

sophie: ok will post updates here. thx :thumbsup:
